notes: Market dynamics rework + large-order impact (SERVER + DB, no client change; pm2 restart, no hard-refresh). Predictability cut: removed the 6h spawn re-home and the +50% graduated pullback (the farmable fade-the-extremes pattern); trends now run, direction is no longer auto-reverted. Wildness cut: per-stock sigma ceiling 0.0015 -> 0.0009, fat-tail multipliers 2.2/1.4 -> 1.7/1.25, removed the invisible rare in-tick spike. News is now a real driver: each company headline applies an instant gap (70%, un-front-runnable off the public feed) plus a thin 2-min decaying drift, ~0.8-2% per real headline vs the old ~0.06% flavor. Anti-farm: orders above F1,000,000 notional now pay slippage and move the tape, scaled per executed leg (buys/covers up, sells/shorts down, symmetric by default), capped 12%; sub-threshold trades unchanged. Required companion fix: _spawnLnP origin is now persisted and restored so the lifetime-gain backstop stops firing off a stale module-eval value after restarts. All thresholds env-tunable (IMPACT_THRESHOLD_C, IMPACT_K, IMPACT_MAX_FRAC, IMPACT_SELL_SIDE, NEWS_GAP_FRAC, NEWS_DRIFT_TICKS). Known limit: notional gating is per-order, so chunked sub-threshold buys can dodge entry impact.
